summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 9,300,000 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase 40,700,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.20 per share. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acts as financial advisor on a reasonable-best-efforts basis, not purchasing securities. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Net proceeds will go to the company. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or any other special-situation event is referenced. The filing is a standard shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
